learning: Iteration 8 confirmed that 60 mm span collapses oval progress (0.301). Bend max_error has stayed at 0.059 to 0.068 m across all changes so far. The s-bend steering oscillation (0.317 at iteration 7) is the next controller lever, to be tested on the next race.
notes: Reproduces the iteration 7 controller on the reverted 50 mm geometry as a clean baseline. Gains are held so the race checks the geometry revert, not a new controller.
rationale: Iteration 7 is the best raced design (399.7; oval progress 0.995, 20 of 20 finishes). Iteration 8 showed that 60 mm span collapses oval progress to 0.301, matching iteration 3, so I accept the Builder's revert to the 50 mm span with 12 mm footprints, y 0.05 and wheel_track 0.10. I keep the iteration 7 controller unchanged (base_speed 1.15, kp 3.75, ki 0.21, kd 0.375, weights -2, -1, 0, 1, 2, last_direction). This race therefore reproduces the best-known configuration as a baseline, so any change in the next result can be attributed to the geometry revert. I considered lowering kd to reduce the s-bend steering oscillation of 0.317, which is above the 0.3 threshold. I did not, because a gain change now would confound the reproduction check and iteration 7 gave the best oval result with a 0.23 oscillation. The s-bend oscillation is the first thing to address in the next controller step. Expected result: score near 400, oval progress at or above 0.95, and bend max_error still on the 0.06 to 0.068 m plateau.
